criteria.criterion: Browse eBay without restricted actions (no sign-in, no bid/cart/purchase)
criteria.final_justification: Evidence supports compliant browsing only. No sign-in, no bidding, no add-to-cart, no purchase flow shown. Keep full credit.

criteria.criterion: Find a laptop listing in the $600–$900 range that appears to meet RAM/SSD thresholds
criteria.final_justification: The agent did identify a candidate in-range listing that appears to meet 16GB/512GB based on the results title/snippet, and opened a product page. This criterion is satisfied even though later verification fails. Keep full credit.

criteria.criterion: Open product detail page and verify RAM and SSD from the item specifics/detail table when available
criteria.final_justification: Critical requirement is to verify BOTH RAM and SSD from the detail table/item specifics. The screenshots do not show any RAM/SSD fields in the item specifics table, so the claimed verification is not supported. The agent did scroll to reach the section, so minimal partial credit for attempt, but not for verification.

criteria.criterion: Report model, price, RAM, and SSD capacity (with confirmation source)
criteria.final_justification: Model and price are supported by the screenshots, but the agent’s report that RAM and SSD were confirmed from the detail table is not supported. Award partial credit for correctly reporting model/price and RAM/SSD values as appearing in the title, but penalize for unverified/incorrectly sourced confirmation claim.

criteria.criterion: Stop after one qualifying laptop is verified, and handle bot-check/CAPTCHA appropriately
criteria.final_justification: Stopping condition (“one qualifying laptop and both specs verified from detail table”) was not met per visual evidence. The agent also provided an output claiming completion despite missing verification. No bot-check handling is needed since none appeared. Score should be reduced substantially.
